description: Presidential Secretariat - Amended Extra Gazette Extraordinary No. 2289/43 of July 22, 2022, with effect from August 23, 2024
reasoning: This gazette contains both a named individual (President Ranil Wickremesinghe) and detailed descriptions of portfolio responsibilities being amended (specifically removing "Department of Project Management and Monitoring" and "Department of Information Technology Management" from the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies' portfolio).
